breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The user's request incorrectly set the gravity vector to the -Z direction for a dam break oriented in the X-Y plane. The agent corrected this by setting the gravity vector to `(0 -9.81 0)`, which correctly applies gravitational force along the negative Y-axis, consistent with the domain's orientation.
